Google.title: Software Engineer II
Google.description: Entry-level engineer. Delivers well-scoped tasks with guidance. Learning codebase, tools, and best practices.

Google.title: Software Engineer III
Google.description: Independent contributor. Owns small features end-to-end. Writes maintainable code and participates in design discussions.

Google.title: Senior Software Engineer
Google.description: Leads projects and drives design decisions. Mentors others and improves system quality.

Google.title: Staff Software Engineer
Google.description: Owns large systems or cross-team initiatives. Sets technical direction and influences multiple teams.

Google.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
Google.description: Drives org-level technical strategy. Solves ambiguous, high-impact problems.

Google.title: Principal Engineer
Google.description: Company-wide impact. Defines technical standards and long-term architecture.
